蛊瘴散尽，晨光遍洒长白山外围山林。

原本浓稠遮天的灰白迷雾彻底褪去，林间毒草成片枯萎发黑，崖壁东瀛咒纹光泽黯淡、裂纹蔓延，失去阵眼滋养，整片百草锁蛊迷魂阵再无半分威能。

幽谷之内，战局尘埃落定。

失去大阵加持的九菊养蛊师织田美子气息紊乱，蛊力溃散，周身黑雾稀薄飘忽，再也维持不住邪蛊气场。她脸色惨白，眼底满是绝望与不甘，看着碎裂的血色祭石，身躯微微颤抖。

三名甲贺忍者被王欣欣、茉沫暗器死死牵制，走位被封、气脉受创，又逢大阵崩塌心神大乱，早已节节败退，只剩勉强格挡之力。

那名雾中阴阳师肩头受创，内伤缠体，铃音断绝、控魂术失灵，缩在幽谷角落，不敢再贸然出手。

大局已定，再无翻盘可能。

范梦雪周身雷光萦绕，缓步逼近织田美子，雷木法尺寒光内敛：“九菊一派潜心养蛊炼毒，祸害关外村镇，以山林地气炼煞，以生魂精血饲蛊，今日落网，已是因果报应。”

织田美子咬着牙，眼底闪过一丝阴狠：“你们破得了外围蛊阵，闯得进长白山，却破不了山巅龙脉祭坛。三大宗门早已布下深层结界，献祭大阵一旦成型，整条关外龙脉都会被阴气浸染，到时候中土大地地气衰败，你们谁也拦不住！”

“龙脉祭坛？”胡九郎眸光骤然一凝。

这话信息量极大，远超众人预估。

原本以为东瀛三派只是盘踞山林、布设阴阵、驯养蛊虫式神，蚕食周边生魂地气，没想到他们野心之大，竟直接盯上了长白山龙脉。

长白山乃东北祖龙分支，地气雄厚，镇御关外山河风水，一旦被邪煞献祭浸染，整片东北气运、地脉根基都会受损，后患无穷。

林佳立刻上前，神色凝重追问：“山巅祭坛在什么位置？献祭大阵到底有什么目的？你们联合阴阳师、甲贺忍盘踞长白山，究竟筹划了多久？”

织田美子却忽然冷笑一声，闭口不再言语，眼底泛起诡异的灰芒，竟是打算以秘术自毁心脉，闭口殉阵。

“想自尽？没那么容易。”

钱丹袖袍轻挥，一只雪白清心蛊凌空飞出，落在织田美子眉心。白蛊微光流转，瞬间封死她体内邪力流转，秘术还未成型便被强行打断。

The miasma has dissipated, and the morning light shines all over the surrounding mountains and forests of Changbai Mountain.

The thick gray fog that originally covered the sky has completely faded. The poisonous weeds in the forest have withered and turned black. The Japanese curse patterns on the cliffs have dimmed luster and spread cracks. They have lost the nourishment of the array eyes. The entire hundred-herb lock Gu enchantment array no longer has half of its power.

In the valley, the battle situation has settled.

The breath of Jiuju Gu Master Oda Miko, who lost the blessing of the formation, was disordered, her Gu power collapsed, the black mist around her body was thin and erratic, and she could no longer maintain the evil Gu aura.Her face was pale, her eyes were full of despair and unwillingness, and her body was trembling slightly as she looked at the broken bloody sacrificial stone.

The three Koga ninjas were tightly restrained by Wang Xinxin and Momo's hidden weapons. Their movement was blocked, their energy veins were injured, and they were confused when the formation collapsed. They had already been retreating steadily, and they could only barely block.

The onmyoji in the mist suffered a shoulder injury, internal injuries all over his body, his ring tone was cut off, and his soul control technique failed. He huddled in the corner of the valley, not daring to take action rashly again.

The overall situation has been decided, and there is no possibility of a comeback.

Fan Mengxue was surrounded by lightning and slowly approached Oda Miko. The cold light of the Thunder Wood Ruler was restrained: "Jiuju's group devoted themselves to cultivating poison and refining poison. They harmed the villages and towns outside the pass. They used the energy of the mountains and forests to refine evil spirits and fed the poison with the essence and blood of living souls. Today's arrest is karma."

Oda Miko gritted her teeth, and a trace of evil flashed in her eyes: "You can break through the outer Gu array and break into Changbai Mountain, but you can't break through the dragon vein altar on the top of the mountain. The three major sects have already set up deep barriers. Once the sacrifice array is formed, the entire dragon vein outside the customs will be saturated with Yin energy. When the earth energy of Middle Earth declines, none of you can stop it!"

"Dragon Vein Altar?" Hu Jiulang's eyes suddenly condensed.

This is a huge amount of information, far exceeding everyone’s expectations.

I originally thought that the three Japanese sects were just entrenched in the mountains and forests, setting up Yin formations, taming Gu insect shikigami, and cannibalizing the surrounding souls and Qi. Unexpectedly, they were so ambitious that they directly targeted the dragon veins of Changbai Mountain.

Changbai Mountain is a branch of the Ancestral Dragon in the Northeast. It has strong earth energy and controls the feng shui of the mountains and rivers outside the pass. Once it is infiltrated by evil spirits, the luck and earth foundation of the entire Northeast will be damaged, and the consequences will be endless.

Lin Jia immediately stepped forward and asked solemnly: "Where is the altar on the top of the mountain? What is the purpose of the sacrifice array? How long have you been planning to join forces with Onmyoji and Koga Ninja to occupy Changbai Mountain?"

However, Oda Miko suddenly sneered and kept silent. A strange gray light appeared in her eyes. She actually planned to use secret techniques to destroy her heart and die in silence.

"Want to commit suicide? It's not that easy."

Qian Dan waved his sleeves lightly, and a snow-white Qingxin Gu flew out of the air and landed on the center of Oda Miko's eyebrows.The white Gu shimmered, instantly blocking the flow of evil power in her body, and the secret technique was forcibly interrupted before it could take shape.
